body_html:
Born and raised in Atlanta, Cole brings unmatched energy and local pride to every event he DJs. With a background in sports entertainment, he’s no stranger to creating unforgettable experiences for crowds of all ages. Whether it’s a wedding, school dance, mitzvah, or corporate event, Cole’s commitment is to make each celebration an absolute hit. From start to finish, he ensures a fun and seamless atmosphere for all, adapting to every vibe with his wide-ranging music expertise.

Outside of DJing, Cole is a sports enthusiast who enjoys collecting baseball cards, analyzing sports stats, and dedicating time to fitness and bodybuilding. With a musical background spanning multiple instruments and experience performing for large audiences, Cole is well-equipped to bring excitement and a true Atlanta spirit to your event.

What’s in Cole’s Headphones: Pop, Hip-Hop, Rap, Country, and Classic Rock.
